articles.title: Circular cities go ‘green’ by reusing things over and over again
articles.snippet: To cut their wastes to nearly zero, circular cities are launching projects to repair, reuse and recycle virtually everything.

articles.title: Sliding down surfaces can make rainwater corrosive
articles.snippet: Water droplets can take on an electric charge when they slide across objects. Charged rain may start to eat through bridges, cars and more, new data show.
